_comment: Baseline snapshot: the TaintBench finding IDs ctadl detects today via a connected source->sink path. 6 of the 17 positive flows connect. Every finding's source and sink is recognized as an endpoint; the 11 misses all end at a FileWriter.append whose taint arrives through a StringBuilder chain the query does not connect. This app was excluded from the suite until the ARM C++ exception unwinder was modelled in native-index.jsonl: its three __aeabi_unwind_cpp_pr* personality routines summarized to ~50,000 rows each and the index did not finish in two hours. With `modes: [skip-analysis]` on them it reaches a fixpoint in about 30 s. See ../../../hybrid-inlining-plateau.md.
